title: BioInteract: Interpretable Drug--Target Interaction Prediction via Residue-Level Cross-Attention with Biological Prior Knowledge
description: Final resubmission release for the BioInteract Davis-benchmark binary high-affinity interaction classifier. The release includes source code, frozen configurations, archived checkpoints, canonical full-precision entity-split predictions and metrics, strict split artifacts, figure-generation scripts, and reproducibility manifests. It documents the initialization-trained exact-sequence-grouped cold-target and cold-both checkpoints. It restores the original Davis baseline-comparison and component-removal tables/figures; the BioInteract full-model rows use current canonical entity-split metrics, while the component-removed values remain the original submitted numerical results. Accordingly, the component-removal differences are descriptive rather than controlled matched-retraining effect estimates. It also provides code, aggregate manifests, and closed pair-level curation accounting for a prespecified strict BindingDB Kd-only exact-double-novel external evaluation with a frozen Davis checkpoint and threshold. The external result indicates limited transfer and is not evidence for broad DTI generalisation, structural contacts, binding pockets, or mechanisms.
